mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS id, m.nickname AS nickname, m.avatar AS avatar, 1 AS isFollow FROM ums_member m WHERE m.id > #{cursor} AND m.id <> #{owner} AND m.del_flag = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_follow f WHERE f.member_id = #{owner} AND f.follow_member_id = m.id) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id AS id, m.nickname AS nickname, m.avatar AS avatar, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_follow b WHERE b.member_id = #{owner} AND b.follow_member_id = m.id) AS isFollow FROM ums_member m WHERE m.id > #{cursor} AND m.id <> #{owner} AND m.del_flag = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_follow f WHERE f.follow_member_id = #{owner} AND f.member_id = m.id) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT #{limit}
